message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• “No‑limit” highways (e.g., I‑10, I‑35) have no posted speed limit, but drivers must still drive at a safe speed for conditions. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 years or 4 ft 9 in tall must be in a child safety seat.
• Children 8–12 years or 4 ft 9 in–5 ft 4 in must use a seat belt. | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08 % or higher is illegal for drivers over 21.
• Lower BAC limits apply to commercial drivers and those under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right yields to the driver on the left.
• Pedestrians always have the right‑of‑way at crosswalks. | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Stopping distance: 20 ft for passenger cars, 30 ft for trucks. | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Drivers must signal before changing lanes.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the vehicle being overtaken is turning left. | | **Headlights & Visibility** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, after dark, or during inclement weather.
• Fog lights may be used only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | | **Towing & Tow‑Vehicle Regulations** | • Tow vehicles must have a tow‑bar or tow‑hook and a tow‑vehicle brake if towing a vehicle over 10 000 lb. | | **Parking** | • Parking on a curb is prohibited if it blocks a driveway, crosswalk, or access to a public facility.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid handicap placard. | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light: Stop; Green light: Go; Yellow light: Slow down/prepare to stop.
• Stop signs require a full stop even if the intersection is clear. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for bodily injury per accident, $25,000 for property damage. | | **Electronic Toll Collection** | • Texas uses the TxTag system for toll roads; drivers must have an active TxTag or pay tolls online within 7 days of travel. | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website for statutes, regulations, and updates. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Legal text detailing all traffic laws. - **Local County Courts** – For specific enforcement actions or changes in local ordinances. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always keep your seat belt fastened.** 2. **Avoid distractions** – especially cell‑phone use. 3. **Observe posted speed limits** and adjust for weather or traffic. 4. **Yield to pedestrians** and school buses. 5. **Check your insurance** annually to ensure compliance. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
